''See also: [[Urzaia Woodsman Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Urzaia Woodsman, also known as the Woodsman, is a powerful [[Izyrian gladiator]] and former member of the [[Champion’s Guild]]. Born in [[Axciss]], he was exiled in bad standing and forced to serve a term in an arena to settle a debt with the [[Imperial]] [[throne]]. During his year of combat, he became an undefeated champion, earning his moniker because his fighting style resembled woodcutting. He survived extreme odds, including battles against creatures like the [[Cinderbeast]] and a [[Houndmaster]], gaining immense strength, heightened senses, and resistance to poisons. His combat prowess is aided by his [[Soulbound Vessel]], the golden hide of a [[Sandborn Hydra]] wrapped around his arm, and a pair of dark, [[Awakened hatchets]] crafted by an [[Izyrian]] smith. Following his liberation from the arena by unknown parties, Urzaia transitioned into a new role as the cook aboard the [[Navigator vessel]], [[The Testament]], serving under [[Imperial Steward Calder Marten|Captain Calder]] [[Marten]]. Despite his cheerful and gap-toothed demeanor, he retains the formidable physical presence and combat instincts of a gladiator. He is characterized by his scarred, tanned skin, mismatched patchwork armor, and immense physical strength, capable of tearing through trees or doors with ease. He is a loyal protector to his crew and has demonstrated significant combat utility in various environments, from defending the ship's deck to engaging enemies in dense forests.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Urzaia is a large, blond man with blue eyes and a scarred face. He has two missing teeth and wears mismatched gladiator regalia consisting of leather straps, chain mesh, and a gold-scaled hide wrapped around his arm. He also wears an ornate belt-buckle carved with a snake eating its own tail.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|An undefeated [[Izyrian gladiator]] and former [[Champion]], Urzaia has defied the [[Emperor's command]] to die in the arena for three years. He is a crew member who serves as the ship's cook and has promised to stand in front of [[Calder]]. In combat, he is capable of responding with an animal roar or fighting in a bloody fury.}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Urzaia is connected to [[Imperial Steward Calder Marten{{!}}Calder Marten]], whom he promised to protect. He was killed by [[Shera]] and also fought against [[Meia]], a [[Consultant]] who possessed enough enhancements to battle him toe-to-toe. Additionally, he has a wife who is described as being fire-hurling.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|As a [[Soulbound]], Urzaia possesses an enhanced body and can draw on the strength of a [[Sandborn Hydra]]. He utilizes [[Awakened weapons]], specifically dual black hatchets, and has the ability to sense the presence of [[Shera]]'s partner.}}

== History ==
=== {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|Crew of The Testament}} ===
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|Urzaia, also known as Woodsman, serves as the cook for the crew of [[The Testament]] where he crafts the ship's meals.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c3">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 3</ref> A large man with a scarred face and two missing teeth, he wears arms wrapped in leather and gold-scaled hide.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c5">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 5</ref><ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c7">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 7</ref> An [[Izyrian gladiator]] and former member of the [[Champion’s Guild|Champion's Guild]], he was once banished to the arena in hopes that fighting would kill him.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c7" /><ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c17">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 17</ref><ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c20">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 20</ref> As a [[Soulbound]] warrior who can draw on the strength of a [[Sandborn Hydra]], he fights using two black hatchets.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c5" /><ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c11">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 11</ref><ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c12">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 12</ref> During his time on watch duty, he responded to a shout from [[Calder]] with an animal roar and later used a [[hatchet]] to strike a bone-crab.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c5" /><ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c11" /><ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c12" /> After tracking a [[Consultant]] target to the far side of an island, he was killed by the [[Consultants]].<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c23">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 23</ref><ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c25">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 25</ref> Following his death, he remains a [[Soulbound]] warrior with a hole in his chest.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c27">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 27</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|Rescue of the Champion}} ===
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|A daring plan is set in motion to rescue Urzaia, with [[Calder]] leading the efforts for the mission.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c17">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 17</ref><ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c19">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 19</ref> During the encounter, Urzaia Woodsman ran toward the [[Cinderbeast]] and rode upon its back like a horseman.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c19" /> While wearing a golden hide around his upper arm, he utilized [[Soulbound powers]] and [[Awakened weapons]] to strike the creature.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c19" /> The crew's primary objective remains to retrieve him.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c21">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 21</ref> Urzaia, who claims to be a very good cook, fights using hatchets and has promised to stand in front of [[Calder]].<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c19" /><ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c23">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 23</ref>}}
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">10</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|There is a daring plan to rescue [[Urzaia Woodsman|Urzaia]].<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c17" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|[[Urzaia Woodsman|Urzaia]] is being planned for rescue by [[Calder]].<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c19" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|[[Urzaia Woodsman]] ran toward the [[Cinderbeast]].<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c19" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|[[Urzaia Woodsman]] rode the [[Cinderbeast]]'s back like a horseman.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c19" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|[[Urzaia Woodsman|Urzaia]] wears a golden hide around his upper arm.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c19" />}}</li>

=== {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Life in the tower}} ===
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Known to the members of [[Calder]]'s crew, Urzaia is a large man with blue eyes and dirty blond hair.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c4">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 4</ref><ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c8">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 8</ref><ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c18">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 18</ref> This [[Champion]] emerged from the woods carrying a [[hatchet]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c8" /><ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c10">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 10</ref> While sleeping in the tower, Urzaia often rests in leather armor and gladiator regalia with weapons kept close at hand.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c10" /><ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c13">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 13</ref><ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c18" /> Urzaia's laughter once echoed over the ocean, and the warrior claimed to be undefeated within the [[Izyrian arena]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c15">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 15</ref><ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c17">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 17</ref> The woodsman also possessed the ability to stem the flow of [[giant worms]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c24">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 24</ref>}}
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">11</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Urzaia Woodsman|Urzaia]] is a person [[Calder]]'s crew members knew.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c4" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Urzaia Woodsman|Urzaia]] has blue eyes.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c8" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Urzaia Woodsman|Urzaia]] emerged from the woods holding a [[hatchet]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c8" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Urzaia Woodsman|Urzaia]] is a [[Champion]] who carries a [[hatchet]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c10" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Urzaia Woodsman|Urzaia]] is sleeping in the tower.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c10" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Urzaia Woodsman|Urzaia]] is someone who often sleeps in their armor and keeps weapons close.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c13" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Urzaia Woodsman{{!}}Urzaia's laughter echoed over the ocean.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c15" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Urzaia Woodsman|Urzaia]] claimed to be undefeated in the [[Izyrian arena]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c17" />}}</li>

<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Urzaia Woodsman|Urzaia]] wears gladiator regalia and leather armor.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c18" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Urzaia Woodsman|Urzaia]] could stem the flow of [[giant worms]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c24" />}}</li>

== Notable quotes ==
* {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|“First, let me introduce the man who crafts all the meals we will enjoy onboard The Testament: Urzaia Woodsman!”<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c3" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|“URZAIA!” An animal roar answered him from the edge of the crater.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c11" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|“Urzaia Woodsman,” she recited. “Former member of the Champion’s Guild, exiled in bad standing, forced to serve a term in an Izyrian arena until his debt to the Imperial throne was cleared, or until his death.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c20" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|“Get ready,” Calder said, hefting his pistol. “Urzaia’s inside.”<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c23" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|“I’m afraid that an interruption right now would just kill him. If he survives long enough, I’ll come back for him.”<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c23" />}}
